customer_not_found: Customer not found. Select an existing customer from the list.
product_not_in_db:
The product "{product} - {variant}" is not in the database.

Do you want to add this product directly and complete the order?
add_product_todo: Code to save the new product needs to be added here.
info_quick_sell: ℹ️ This will create an invoice and deduct items from inventory instantly.
confirm_delete_order: Are you sure you want to delete this order? This will revert any physical inventory deductions.
products_catalog_desc: Manage your main products, variants, and shortcuts.
no_variants: No variants found. Add one using the form above.
availability_subtitle: Read-only overview of supply and pallet content per variant and unit.
availability_basis_no_reservations: Reservations are not subtracted yet: “Available now” is always before reservations.
availability_basis_no_legacy: The legacy inventory register (Inventory) is not included; only commitments and pallet content from the new model.
availability_basis_weights: Kilograms are only actually weighed net weights of pallet content; nothing is estimated or converted.
availability_no_results: No rows match this search or unit.
availability_empty_title: No supply or pallet content has been registered yet.
availability_empty_description: As soon as commitments and pallets are recorded in the system, they appear here.
availability_warehouse_hint: Per variant and unit; units are never merged or converted.
availability_direct_hint: Bound to one customer. Not freely sellable and never added to warehouse supply.
availability_col_expected_unregistered: Expected, not on a pallet yet
availability_show_closed_history_hint: Dispatched, delivered or cancelled. Never counts towards availability.
availability_history_hint: For information only: these lines are not active availability.
availability_warning_source_unit_unknown: Source without unit: expected cannot be offset
availability_warning_direct_trade_in_war: Customer-bound content in warehouse: counted nowhere, please check
availability_error_config: API address not set or invalid (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL): {detail}
availability_error_shape: Unexpected response from the server; no figures are shown.
availability_focus_expected: Expected, not on a pallet yet
availability_link_invalid: Invalid filter in the link ignored: {fields}
supply_subtitle: Plan supply and receive pallets. Every registration is recorded immediately.
supply_actor_hint: Required for pallet registration (audit). Remembered in this browser.
supply_destination_warehouse_hint: Planned supply to our warehouse; no physical pallet yet.
supply_destination_direct_hint: Customer-bound supply from supplier to customer and destination; never general stock.
supply_mode_receive_hint: Register a physical pallet against planned supply.
supply_direct_receive_later: Registering direct-trade shipments or pallets follows in a later version.
supply_direct_banner: Customer-bound: never becomes general warehouse stock and is never shown as available.
supply_destination_placeholder: For example country, city or delivery address
supply_plan_footer: One click per request; a repeat never stores anything twice.
supply_saved_before: This request had already been saved; nothing was recorded twice.
supply_error_required_customer: Choose the customer: direct trade is always customer-bound.
supply_error_duplicate_line: This variant with this lot is already in another line.
supply_error_actor_required: Enter the employee at the top.
supply_error_sscc: Not a valid SSCC (18 digits with GS1 check digit).
supply_error_select_source: Choose at least one planned supply line.
supply_error_source_unit_missing: Unit is missing in the source; receipt cannot be registered yet.
supply_error_http_400: The server rejected the input. Check the highlighted fields.
supply_error_http_404: A chosen supplier, customer, variant, pallet or source line does not exist (anymore).
supply_error_http_409: The server rejected this because it conflicts with the current data.
supply_error_outcome_unknown: It is unknown whether this was already saved. Try again with the same data; nothing will be recorded twice.
supply_receive_sources_hint: Only planned supply for the own warehouse. Supplier, product and unit come from the plan.
supply_receive_no_sources: There is no planned supply for the own warehouse yet. Plan supply first.
supply_receive_no_matches: No planned supply matches this search.
supply_pallet_fixed_state: You are registering a pallet that was received in our own warehouse.
supply_pallet_sscc_hint: Only a real scanned SSCC; never generated.
supply_content_empty: Choose one or more source lines above.
supply_open_loading: not on a pallet yet: loading…
supply_open_unknown: not on a pallet yet: unknown
supply_quality_start_hint: always starts in quarantine; inspection follows separately
supply_receive_footer: First the pallet, then each line. Repeating within this screen never stores anything twice.
supply_abandoned_notice: Pallet {reference} is already registered with {done} of {total} lines. There is no recovery or search flow yet: write down the reference; after leaving or refreshing this input cannot be continued here.
supply_receive_success_where: Received in the warehouse · location: {bin}. All content is in quarantine.
supply_to_inspection: Go to inspection for this pallet
inspection_subtitle: Assess quality per content line on received pallets in the own warehouse.
inspection_actor_hint: Required for every decision and shown on the line. Choosing a name changes no quality; this is not a secured account identity.
inspection_scope_note: Only content lines on pallets with status Received in the own warehouse. Always per line, never per pallet or in bulk.
inspection_available_note: Only Approved counts in “Available now (before reservations)”; Quarantine, Blocked and Rejected do not.
inspection_single_pallet: You are viewing one pallet from a link.
inspection_queue_empty: There are no content lines to assess.
inspection_queue_empty_hint: Receive a pallet via Supply first; new content always starts in quarantine.
inspection_not_in_warehouse: This pallet has not been received in the own warehouse (status {status} · location {location}). Inspection is not possible here.
inspection_nothing_to_inspect: This pallet has no content lines left to assess.
inspection_no_lines_in_filter: No lines left to inspect on this pallet.
inspection_not_counts_now: does not count in Available now
inspection_effect_counts: After this assessment the line counts in “Available now (before reservations)”.
inspection_effect_not_counts: After this assessment the line does not count in “Available now”.
inspection_error_reason_required: A reason is required for this assessment.
inspection_conflict: This line was changed in the meantime (by someone else or in another screen). Reload the current data before deciding again.
inspection_reload_failed: The current data of this pallet could not be loaded. Use Refresh.
inspection_availability_failed: The assessment was saved, but the current availability could not be loaded.
inspection_notice_not_counts: Does not count in “Available now (before reservations)”.
inspection_notice_current: Current Available now (before reservations) for this variant in {unit}: {quantity} · {kg}.
inspection_notice_no_supply: There is currently no warehouse supply for this variant in {unit}.
availability_basis_reservations_applied: Active sales reservations are subtracted in “Available after reservations”; “Available now” stays before reservations.
availability_warning_reservation_on_hold: Reservation on content that is no longer approved (+{quantity}); not counted as available
availability_warning_reservation_exceeds: Reservations exceed the content; please check
availability_warning_reservation_outside: Reservation on content outside the warehouse; please check
orders_legacy_notice: This is the legacy order flow with the legacy inventory. New sales orders with traceable reservations are created in Sales; nothing is synchronised between the two.
sales_subtitle: Create a sales order, reserve exact approved stock, dispatch and release it again. No prices, VAT or invoices.
sales_actor_hint: Required for every order, reservation and release (audit). Remembered in this browser.
sales_direct_trade_note: Warehouse stock (route Warehouse) is reserved on pallets. Customer-bound DirectTrade supply is allocated per order line with 'Allocate customer-bound supply' and is never warehouse stock.
sales_new_order_hint: Existing customer, requested delivery date and per line a variant with an explicit unit and quantity.
sales_save_footer: One click per request; a repeat never saves anything twice.
sales_error_duplicate_line: This variant with this unit is already on another line; use one line per variant + unit.
sales_error_exceeds_available: More than is still available on this content line.
sales_error_exceeds_demand: More than the remaining demand of this order line.
sales_error_remainder_mismatch: The full remaining quantity belongs with the full remaining kg, and vice versa; otherwise an unusable remainder is left behind.
sales_error_unit_mismatch: The unit of this stock differs from the order line; units are never converted.
sales_no_orders: There are no sales orders in the new flow yet.
sales_no_orders_hint: Create the first sales order with the button above.
sales_no_matches: No sales orders match this filter.
sales_list_capped: The list shows at most 200 orders (newest first).
sales_select_order_hint: Choose an order on the left to reserve or release, or create a new sales order.
sales_order_on_hold_notice: {count} reservation(s) are on content that is no longer approved (on hold). They do not count as available; release them or wait for re-inspection.
sales_order_not_open: This order is not open; reserving and releasing is not possible.
sales_no_reservations: No reservations on this line yet.
sales_on_hold_hint: Content no longer approved: does not count as available.
sales_release_based_on_version: Release based on reservation version {version}; if the reservation changed in the meantime the server refuses (409).
sales_stock_rules: Only approved content on a received pallet in the warehouse, with the same variant and unit. DirectTrade never appears here.
sales_stock_empty: No reservable stock for this line.
sales_stock_empty_hint: There is currently no approved warehouse stock of this variant in {unit}. Check Inspection or Availability.
sales_reserve_kg_hint: enter explicitly; never calculated from boxes or size
sales_full_remainder_not_fit: Not possible: the remainder ({available}) does not fit the remaining demand ({open}).
sales_remaining_demand_pending: Enter the quantity to see the remaining demand after this reservation.
sales_remaining_demand_after: After this reservation {remaining} {unit} of demand remains open.
sales_conflict: The stock or order changed in the meantime (by someone else or in another screen). Nothing was saved. Reload and decide again.
sales_reload_failed: The action was processed, but the order could not be reloaded. Refresh before deciding further.
sales_notice_availability: Current availability in {unit}: before reservations {before}, reserved {reserved}, after reservations {after} ({afterKg}).
sales_notice_availability_failed: The action was saved, but the current availability could not be loaded.
sales_order_complete_on_hold: Fully reserved, but not ready: reservations are on hold.
sales_pending_title: {count} unresolved action(s) with an unknown outcome
sales_pending_hint: These commands may already have been processed. They are kept (also after navigating away and back) and can only be resent unchanged; a new command never takes their place. Other orders remain readable.
sales_pending_kept: This command is kept until its outcome is known; only the exact same retry is possible.
sales_pending_blocked_line: There is an unresolved action on this order line or on the order itself (cancellation). Resolve it first; until then no new reservation or release is possible here.
sales_pending_stock_missing: This content line is not (or no longer) in the reservable stock; the command may already have been processed. Retry it to be sure.
sales_cancel_hint: All active reservations of this order are released in the same transaction; the order is kept with its reason and history. Cancelling individual lines is not possible (yet).
sales_cancel_will_release: These {count} active reservation(s) will be released:
sales_cancel_nothing_to_release: There are no active reservations to release.
sales_cancel_released_stay: Reservations that were already released stay unchanged.
sales_cancel_blocked: There is an unresolved reservation or release on a line of this order. Resolve it first; until then the order cannot be cancelled.
sales_cancel_consumed: This order has consumed reservations; the server refuses cancellation (409). Returns and shipment corrections belong to a separate flow.
sales_cancel_based_on_version: Cancellation based on order version {version}; if the order or a reservation changed in the meantime the server refuses (409).
sales_notice_cancelled: The cancellation was processed; all active reservations were released.
sales_pending_cancel: Cancellation of order #{id} ({customer}, {count} reservation(s) to release)
sales_cancel_replay_only: This order is no longer open. An unresolved cancellation can only be resent unchanged; the server then returns the current state.
sales_dispatch_hint: Choose whole reservations; quantity, unit and net kg come from the reservation and are never calculated. Stock is written off in the same transaction; the pallet status does not change.
sales_dispatch_nothing: There are no reservations on this order.
sales_dispatch_based_on_version: Dispatch based on order version {version} and the versions of the chosen reservations; if anything changed in the meantime the server refuses (409).
sales_dispatch_blocked: There is an unresolved action on this order or one of its lines. Resolve it first; until then nothing can be dispatched.
sales_dispatch_replay_only: According to the server the chosen reservations are already (partly) consumed; this command may already have been processed. Only the identical retry resolves it: the server then returns the existing dispatch.
sales_notice_dispatched: Dispatch #{id} saved: {count} reservation(s) consumed and written off.
sales_dispatches_empty: No dispatches for this order yet.
sales_cancel_after_dispatch: An order with dispatched reservations cannot be cancelled; returns belong to a separate flow.
sales_correct_hint: Administrative correction of a dispatch that was registered by mistake. The original dispatch is kept; nothing is deleted.
sales_correct_lines: All {count} line(s) of this dispatch will be reversed:
sales_correct_effect_quarantine: Per line a new content line is created in quarantine on the same pallet (same lot), with exactly the dispatched quantity and net kg. It becomes sellable only after inspection.
sales_correct_effect_order: The reservations are marked as corrected and the customer demand reopens; no reservations are recreated.
sales_correct_effect_pallet: The pallet keeps its status and location.
sales_correct_effect_history: Dispatch, movements and history stay unchanged; the correction is added as a new, linked record.
sales_correct_not_a_return: This is not a return: goods that were at the customer belong in the receipt and inspection flow, not here.
sales_correct_confirm_label: I confirm that these goods never left the warehouse.
sales_correct_confirm_hint: This confirmation is yours and is recorded as such in the audit; the software cannot establish it by itself.
sales_correct_confirm_required: First confirm that the goods never left the warehouse.
sales_correct_based_on_version: Correction based on order version {version} and the reservation versions; if anything changed in the meantime the server refuses (409).
sales_correct_already: This dispatch has already been corrected.
sales_correct_replay_only: According to the server this dispatch is already corrected; this command may already have been processed. Only the identical retry resolves it: the server then returns the existing correction and never restores stock twice.
sales_corrected_reservation: Reversed by correction #{id}; no longer counts as dispatched or reserved.
sales_notice_corrected: Dispatch #{id} corrected: {count} line(s) restored in quarantine.
sales_notice_corrected_next: The customer demand is open again. Inspect the restored content before reserving it again.
sales_refresh_failed: Refresh failed; you still see the previous data. Open input and unresolved actions are kept.
sales_list_refresh_failed: The list could not be refreshed; you still see the previous list.
availability_view_hint_compact: Compact: physically in warehouse, reserved, available after reservations, quarantine and expected supply. Choose “All columns” for the full breakdown.
inventory_legacy_notice: This is the legacy inventory registration. The current warehouse stock with pallets, inspection and reservations is in Availability; nothing is synchronised between the two.
invoices_legacy_notice: This is the legacy invoice flow. Sales orders from Sales are not invoiced here; nothing is synchronised.
placeholder_not_available: This part is not available yet. Nothing is tracked or followed here.
help_text: A manual and contact details are not available yet. Use the Sales, Supply, Inspection and Availability workspaces for the daily warehouse flow.
start_subtitle: Choose a workspace. Every workspace works on the same current stock.
start_sales_desc: Sales orders, reservations, dispatches and corrections.
start_supply_desc: Plan supply and receive pallets, always into quarantine.
start_availability_desc: Current stock per variant and unit, before and after reservations.
start_legacy_desc: Orders, inventory and invoices from the legacy registration are separate and not synchronised.
start_legacy_metrics_notice: These figures come from the legacy registration and are partly fixed sample values. They are only visible because NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOW_LEGACY_DEMO_CHROME is on.
sales_new_customer_hint: Only the details the warehouse and office need. After saving, the customer is selected in this order; your order input is kept.
sales_customer_created: Customer "{name}" created and selected in this order.
sales_customer_similar_live: Looks like existing customer(s): {names}. Check whether you mean one of them; names do not have to be unique.
sales_customer_similar_title: Customers with a similar name already exist
sales_customer_similar_hint: The customer was not created. Choose an existing customer below, or create a new customer anyway if it really is a different one. The comparison looks at the name only (case, accents and punctuation are ignored).
sales_customer_create_anyway: Create as a new customer anyway
sales_customer_error_invalid_email: This does not look like an e-mail address.
sales_customer_pending_replay_only: This customer command is still open. Only the identical retry is possible; you can close the panel, the command is kept.
sales_customer_blocked_by_order: Finish the unresolved sales order before adding a customer.
sales_allocate_rules: Only DirectTrade supply of the same customer, with the same variant and unit, in status Expected or Partially received. This is expected supply: no stock, no quality, no measured kg. Warehouse availability does not change.
sales_allocate_empty: No allocatable customer-bound supply for this line.
sales_allocate_empty_hint: There is no DirectTrade supply for {customer} of this variant in {unit} with remaining quantity. Plan it first under Supply.
sales_declared_kg_hint: Weight declared by the supplier for the whole source line; not measured and never the weight of a (partial) allocation.
sales_allocate_warning_title: Expected supply, no stock and no shipment
sales_allocate_warning: These goods are not in our warehouse and have not been shipped. The supplier expects to deliver on {date}. An allocation only records customer demand against expected supply; warehouse availability does not change.
sales_allocate_date_warning: Note: the expected delivery date ({expected}) is after the requested delivery date of the order ({requested}).
sales_allocate_acknowledge: I understand this is expected supply: not in our warehouse, not shipped and not ready.
sales_allocate_acknowledge_required: First confirm that this is expected supply; nothing is recorded without that confirmation.
sales_allocate_remaining_on_source: Still allocatable on this source line
sales_allocate_full_remainder_hint: {quantity} {unit}: the smaller of still allocatable on the source and open demand
sales_remaining_demand_after_allocation: After this allocation {remaining} {unit} of customer demand stays open.
sales_notice_allocated: Allocation of expected, customer-bound supply recorded. This is not stock and not a shipment.
sales_pending_supply_missing: This source line is no longer in the allocatable supply; the command may already have been processed. Repeat exactly the same command to learn the outcome.
sales_line_complete_expected: Fully committed, of which {quantity} expected (not ready)
sales_line_complete_expected_hint: This line is fully committed, but {quantity} {unit} is expected customer-bound supply: no stock, not ready.
sales_order_complete_expected: Fully committed, but not ready: {count} line(s) rely on expected customer-bound supply.
sales_order_allocated_notice: {count} line(s) have allocations of expected customer-bound supply. Those goods are not in our warehouse and are not dispatched from the warehouse.
sales_dispatch_allocations_excluded: {count} allocation(s) of expected customer-bound supply are not in this list: they are never dispatched from the warehouse.
sales_error_exceeds_remaining: More than still allocatable on this source line.
sales_list_allocated: {count} line(s) on expected customer-bound supply (not ready)
sales_allocate_expected_date_snapshot: as shown when this command was submitted; the source line is no longer listed
sales_ship_hint: Customer-bound supply goes from supplier to customer, outside our warehouse. Choose whole allocations and record the actual shipped net kg and lot.
sales_ship_warning: After recording, the allocation shows 'Shipped · delivery not yet confirmed'. Warehouse stock, warehouse reservations and availability do not change; nothing is received into the warehouse.
sales_ship_nothing: This order has no DirectTrade allocations.
sales_ship_kg_hint: measured or declared at shipment; never derived from expected supply
sales_ship_no_source_lot: the source line has no lot; enter the actual lot
sales_ship_lot_deviates: differs from source lot {source}; both are recorded
sales_ship_lot_reason_required: Explain why the actual lot differs from the source lot.
sales_ship_whole_only: Whole allocations only: quantity and unit are those of the allocation. If the supplier shipped less, release the allocation and allocate the actual quantity; if more, allocate the extra first.
sales_ship_date_future: The shipping date is after today (Europe/Amsterdam); only shipments that happened can be recorded.
sales_ship_reference_placeholder: for example CMR or carrier reference
sales_ship_replay_only: This command may already have been processed: the allocations already show as shipped. Repeat exactly the same command to learn the outcome.
sales_ship_blocked: Another unresolved action is pending on this order. Resolve that first.
sales_notice_dt_shipped_next: Delivery is not yet confirmed. Warehouse stock is unchanged.
sales_dt_correct_hint: Only for a recorded shipment that did not take place. A real return or a correction of only kg, lot or part of the quantity is a different flow.
sales_dt_correct_lines: All lines of this shipment are taken back
sales_dt_correct_effect_history: The original shipment, lines and snapshots stay visible unchanged; a linked correction is added.
sales_dt_correct_effect_demand: The shipped quantity no longer counts as shipped; the order demand opens again.
sales_dt_correct_effect_capacity: Source capacity is freed and can be allocated again, provided the commitment still meets the conditions.
sales_dt_correct_effect_no_allocation: No allocation is restored; allocate again if needed.
sales_dt_correct_effect_no_stock: No warehouse stock, pallet, stock movement or return receipt.
sales_dt_correct_confirm_label: This recorded shipment did not take place.
sales_dt_correct_confirm_required: Confirm that this recorded shipment did not take place; nothing is recorded without that confirmation.
sales_dt_correct_replay_only: This command may already have been processed: the shipment already shows as taken back. Repeat exactly the same command to learn the outcome.
sales_dt_correct_blocked: Another unresolved action is pending on this order. Resolve that first.
sales_dt_corrected_badge: Taken back · did not take place
sales_dt_corrected_kg_hint: taken back; no longer counts as shipped
sales_notice_dt_corrected_next: The order demand is open again and source capacity has been freed. No allocation was restored.
sales_delivery_hint: Only for a shipment delivered to the customer in full and without deviations. Stock, source capacity, reservations and shipped quantities do not change.
sales_delivery_date_hint: calendar date; not before the shipping date and not after today (Europe/Amsterdam)
sales_delivery_reference_placeholder: for example signed CMR or receipt
sales_delivery_confirm_label: This shipment was delivered in full and without deviations.
sales_delivery_warning: Do not confirm on shortage, damage, partial receipt or return; that cannot be recorded yet.
sales_delivery_confirm_required: Confirm that this shipment was delivered in full and without deviations; nothing is recorded without that confirmation.
sales_delivery_date_future: The delivery date is after today (Europe/Amsterdam); only deliveries that happened can be confirmed.
sales_delivery_date_before_shipping: The delivery date is before the shipping date.
sales_delivery_replay_only: This command may already have been processed: the delivery already shows as confirmed. Repeat exactly the same command to learn the outcome.
sales_delivery_blocked: Another unresolved action is pending on this order. Resolve that first.
sales_notice_delivery_confirmed_next: Stock, source capacity and shipped quantities are unchanged. An administrative correction of this shipment is only possible after retracting the confirmation.
sales_line_shipped_not_confirmed: Fully shipped · delivery not yet (fully) confirmed
sales_order_shipped_not_confirmed: Fully shipped · delivery not yet (fully) confirmed
sales_retract_hint: Only for a confirmation that was recorded in error. A real return, damage or shortage is out of scope.
sales_retract_effect_kept: The original confirmation stays in the history, with this retraction linked to it.
sales_retract_effect_status: The shipment is then back to 'Shipped · delivery not yet confirmed'.
sales_retract_effect_delivered: The order's confirmed delivered quantity decreases by {quantities}.
sales_retract_effect_no_stock: Stock, source capacity, reservations and shipped quantities do not change.
sales_retract_effect_next: Afterwards the delivery can be confirmed again with a new command, or the shipment can be corrected if the other conditions apply.
sales_retract_confirm_label: This delivery confirmation was recorded in error.
sales_retract_warning: Do not use for a return, damage or shortage; those cannot be recorded yet.
sales_retract_confirm_required: Confirm that this delivery confirmation was recorded in error; nothing is retracted without that confirmation.
sales_retract_replay_only: This command may already have been processed: the confirmation already shows as retracted. Repeat exactly the same command to learn the outcome.
sales_notice_delivery_retracted_next: The shipment is back to 'delivery not yet confirmed'. Stock, source capacity and shipped quantities are unchanged.
demo_no_ai_label: Fixed tour and search, no AI. Changes nothing.
demo_tour_intro: A short tour of Supply, Inspection, Availability and Sales. The assistant only opens pages; you perform every action yourself.
demo_step_supply_body: Plan supply and receive pallets here. Each pallet gets content lines per variant and unit, with lot and origin, and every registration is recorded immediately with the employee.
demo_step_inspection_body: Received pallets start in quarantine. The inspector decides per content line: approve, block or reject. Only approved stock can be sold; every decision is in the audit trail.
demo_step_availability_body: Read-only overview per variant and unit: in transit, in quarantine, approved and still free after reservations. Kg is never derived from quantities.
demo_step_sales_body: Sales orders with order lines. Warehouse stock is reserved and dispatched exactly per pallet and lot; customer-bound DirectTrade supply is allocated separately. Use 'Find order' to open an order quickly.
demo_search_hint: Searches the existing order list (the 200 most recent orders) by order number, customer name or customer reference.
demo_search_error: The order list could not be loaded. Please try again.
product_picker_placeholder: Type product, variant, origin or shortcut code…
product_picker_hint: Type to search. Arrows pick a suggestion, Enter confirms, Escape closes. Tab only accepts a clear suggestion.
product_picker_more: And {count} more; keep typing to narrow down.
inspection_history_no_quality: No inspection decision for this line yet.
inspection_no_pallets_in_filter: No pallets within the chosen quality filters.
